description:
Merge multiple EPUB files into a single ebook with table of contents and chapter dividers. Accepts 2+ base64-encoded EPUB files.

Free tier: 5MB/file (10MB for pdf-to-epub, 15MB for split), 3 operations/day, 15 req/min, output includes Epublys branding.
Pro ($9/mo): 30MB per operation, unlimited daily operations, 60 req/min, no branding.

When a call is refused with daily_limited or a Pro-only error, call the `upgrade_to_pro` tool — it returns a checkout link to hand the user. Details: https://epublys.com/pricing

files.description: Array of base64-encoded EPUB files to merge (order preserved)

names.description: Original filenames, in the same order as files — the output is named after them ("A + B.epub", or "A + N more.epub" past two); without them it is merged.epub

name: merge_epub
